description: This file defines repository functions for managing commit data in a database, including inserting commits, retrieving most recent commits, and fetching first seen timestamps for commits. It also provides null object pattern implementation for error handling.

classes.name: NullCommit
classes.description: A null object implementation of commit interface returning stored error on method calls.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to interact with commit data in the database, including insert, fetch latest, and get first seen timestamps.

methods.name: InsertCommitRows
methods.description: Inserts a list of commit rows into the database.

methods.name: GetFirstSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Fetches the earliest timestamp for given commits, returns default null timestamp for missing commits.

methods.name: GetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent commit's timestamp and UUID for the current target.

methods.name: GetMostRecentCommits
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent commit rows for the current target.

methods.name: WithTimestampGenerator
methods.description: Returns a new Commit instance with a custom timestamp generator function.
